model.name: R19.73: In-room file click opens ContentPreviewer — image/html/href preview works in room context.
model.description: PRIORITY: clicking a file in the IN-ROOM file tree (RoomView Members/Files tree) MUST open the ContentPreviewer (R19.65) in a detail view/drawer within the room context — image renders as img, html/href renders in sandboxed iframe, etc. Currently preview works in /trace detail but NOT on in-room file-click. REUSE the existing ContentPreviewer DRY (same component as /trace, not a reimplementation). The room tree file-click handler must invoke the same preview path that /trace uses.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (PRIORITY): "prioritize making the image and html/href preview work IN THE ROOM."
model.crossRefNote: R19.64 (preview by type), R19.65 (ContentPreviewer component), R19.63 (file click shows preview in drawer) — all define the preview system. R19.73 ensures it works IN THE ROOM context, not just /trace. DRY reuse.
